title: I have never pretended to be anyone else Except for every day when I know who I am #smallpoems
summary: I have never pretended to be anyone else Except for every day when I know who I am #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I have never
  pretended
to be anyone
  else
Except for
every day
  when I
know who
I     am
#smallpoems
